candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis requires pulmonary sarcomatoid carcinoma as the histologic entity and stage IVA (cT4N2M1a). C001 captures only the KEAP1 mutation and TMB status, which are molecular components of the same tumor but omit the defining sarcomatoid histology (supported by IHC pattern: CK7+++, S-100+, vimentin+, TTF1−, NapsinA−, P40−, EMA−, SMA−, Desmin−) and the staging information derived from imaging (bilateral nodules, mediastinal lymphadenopathy, pleural thickening indicating M1a disease).
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies a molecular feature (KEAP1 mutation, low TMB) of the tumor but does not specify the histologic subtype (sarcomatoid carcinoma), the primary organ (lung is implied but not explicit), or the stage (IVA, cT4N2M1a)

case_quality_flags: IHC profile across two biopsies is consistent with sarcomatoid carcinoma (pleomorphic or spindle-cell variant) rather than adenocarcinoma or squamous cell carcinoma; TTF1/NapsinA negativity and vimentin/S-100 positivity support this
Stage IVA assignment relies on bilateral pulmonary nodules (M1a) plus cT4 primary and N2 mediastinal nodes; pleural thickening also contributes to M1a consideration
KEAP1 mutation is a recognized driver in sarcomatoid carcinoma but does not define the histologic diagnosis
